hypothesis: the exact owned fresh FiveK DNG and Expert-C files can be converted into at least 60 deterministic content-aligned sRGB16 pairs with sufficient camera support and zero cross-split leakage, without fitting any colour operator

normalization.source_decode: project WorkingImage generic RAW decode then exact sRGB encoding
normalization.target_decode: Expert-C ProPhoto RGB16 TIFF through pinned ProPhoto-to-D50-to-D65-to-sRGB conversion
normalization.crop_policy: geometry-only centered source crop to the target aspect ratio
normalization.resize_policy: Lanczos4, preserve source crop aspect, maximum side 1536, then target to exact source shape

branch_rules.all_gates_pass: freeze the exact normalized manifest and open one unchanged AY3 fresh confirmation
branch_rules.alignment_fails: close fresh confirmation on this selection without per-image registration, manual crop or row substitution
branch_rules.support_or_leakage_fails: close fresh confirmation and retain the data only as internal diagnostics
branch_rules.individual_rows_fail: retain explicit rejection reasons; up to four rows may remain unassigned

claim_ceiling: data-only deterministic normalization, content alignment, camera support and leakage evidence for fresh FiveK digital-retouch pairs; no operator, film, stock, calibration, preference or product claim
